closest_prior_work.work: Task14 L11H3 same-syntax all-source value atlas
closest_prior_work.relation: Its singleton scan found strong subject and first-post-subject values and material downstream nonadditivity. It did not causally evaluate combinations or interactions among semantic source groups.
Earlier localization used whole modules or singleton positions rather than an exact powerset of below-head semantic source-value groups.

novelty: Exact 16-corner causal factorial over four semantic groups of L11H3 source values under fixed recipient scores: subject; first post-subject syntax token; remaining bridge tokens before the attractor determiner; and attractor determiner+noun. It measures whether subject-conditioned information is a compact early relay, distributed across bridge values, or interaction-dependent in downstream task behavior.
required_controls: empty subset reproduces native replay and full subset reproduces the atlas joint-all-values arm
complete same-syntax donor head is a live ceiling in every cell
groups form a disjoint exhaustive partition of source positions 1 through final; source 0 is the proven no-op
all 16 subsets are evaluated exactly with task margin primary and CE supporting
opposing_interpretations: compact early relay: S+I recovers at least 70 percent of the joint-all-value margin in every cell
distributed bridge: S+I falls short, while S+I+B recovers at least 80 percent in every cell
attractor phrase is required: adding A to S+I+B contributes at least 10 percent of joint margin in some cell
downstream interaction dependence: some order-2-or-higher factorial dividend is at least 10 percent of the joint margin
interpretation_limits: The factorial groups causal source values, not upstream writers that created those values.
Möbius dividends describe downstream task nonadditivity under this intervention family and are not unique ontology labels.
TEST is reused; OOD, selective removal, and circuit completeness remain closed.
known_lessons_applied: Use exact causal group combinations instead of assigning unique importance from nonlinear singleton effects.
Use answer margin and CE, never activation reconstruction, variance, rank, or quantization.
Only the atlas-selected semantic grouping is tested; no backup suite precedes a signal.
